overall: MARGINAL overall: five grounds are GOOD (Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Decabobo, Panlaitan), the east side stays windy and POOR, and Nangalao is VERY POOR
limiterDetail: The main limiter is east wind (Nangalao 20–24 kt, Cabunlawan/Decabaitot 18–23 kt, Ciron 17–22 kt, Barangonan 18–22 kt all 24h), then current late today: Decabaitot, Alava and Barangonan climb to 1.9–2.4 kt from about 11 PM to 3 AM Tuesday, and Culion and Binudac reach about 1.5 kt. Rain is light: 0.1–0.4 mm/h on and off, with Coron, Culion and Galoc about 0.4 mm/h early this morning and Barangonan 0.4 mm/h near 1–3 AM Tuesday.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning matching Calamian / MIMAROPA in the recent feed. See the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the last digest (Sat 7 Nov, 6:20 AM)
items: Fishing improved to 5 GOOD / 5 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 1 VERY POOR (was 2 GOOD / 7 MARGINAL / 3 POOR / 4 VERY POOR). The Saturday evening and Sunday digests did not publish (the dashboard server was down), so this compares against Saturday morning. Maglalambay, Panlaitan and Decabobo are GOOD again, and Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan are back out of VERY POOR into POOR as east wind eased to 18–19 kt. Nangalao (20 kt, gusts 27) is the only VERY POOR ground.

The east side is still too windy (18–24 kt through Tuesday morning), so this is a partial recovery. Today the regional wind is 10 kt, gusts 16, with light rain (about 1.5 mm). Wed 11 and Thu 12 are the roughest days ahead (14 kt, gusts 20–21). Shortage detector ELEVATED Mon–Sat; surge OFF. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF. The shortage detector is ELEVATED for Mon–Sat (guide only). Tightening risk is moderate to high around Thu 12–Fri 13 arrivals after the Wed–Thu wind. Lean on Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan and Decabobo for supply.

bestWindow.headline: About 10 AM–1 PM at Decabobo, Tara and Turda; Coron/Galoc 12–5 PM
details: Decabobo: about 12 noon, when wind drops to 0 kt and current is 0.2 (dashboard best hour ~Mon 12). Coron and Galoc: workable all day and lightest about 12–5 PM (4–5 kt), current 0.2–0.5. Maglalambay and Panlaitan: wind 5–7 kt about 10 AM–6 PM, current ≤0.3. Tara and Turda: wind 0–5 kt about 10 AM–1 PM but current is 0.6–0.9; better after about 11 PM when current eases to 0.1–0.3 kt.
Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan (18–24 kt, gusts to 27), and avoid Decabaitot, Alava and Barangonan tonight (current 2.1–2.4 kt about 1–3 AM).
